name: [CernoIA PROD] WF-015 — Extracción IA de requisitos documentales

parameters.query:
WITH active_lock AS (
    SELECT
        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.status,
        cursor.lock_expires_at

    FROM ops.sync_cursors AS cursor

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          'SECOP_OPPORTUNITY_REQUIREMENT_EXTRACTION'

    LIMIT 1
),

recovered AS (
    UPDATE saas.opportunity_documents
        AS document

    SET
        ai_requirement_status =
            'queued',

        ai_requirement_started_at =
            NULL,

        ai_requirement_finished_at =
            NULL,

        ai_requirement_error =
            'Análisis de requisitos recuperado después de permanecer bloqueado.',

        ai_requirement_attempt_count =
            GREATEST(
                COALESCE(
                    document.ai_requirement_attempt_count,
                    0
                ) - 1,
                0
            ),

        metadata =
            (
                COALESCE(
                    document.metadata,
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )
                - 'active_requirement_execution_id'
                - 'active_requirement_started_at'
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'requirement_recovered_at',
                NOW(),

                'requirement_recovered_by',
                'WF-015'
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    WHERE document.ai_requirement_status =
          'running'

      AND COALESCE(
          document.ai_requirement_started_at,
          document.updated_at
      ) <
          NOW() - INTERVAL '45 minutes'

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1

          FROM active_lock AS lock

          WHERE lock.status =
                'running'

            AND lock.lock_expires_at >
                NOW()

            AND lock.active_execution_id =
                COALESCE(
                    document.metadata
                        ->> 'active_requirement_execution_id',
                    ''
                )
      )

    RETURNING
        document.id,
        document.process_reference,
        document.document_name
)

SELECT
    COUNT(*)
        AS recovered_documents,

    COALESCE(
        JSONB_AGG(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'opportunity_document_id',
                recovered.id,

                'process_reference',
                recovered.process_reference,

                'document_name',
                recovered.document_name
            )
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE recovered.id IS NOT NULL
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS recovered_items,

    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(*) = 0
            THEN 'no_stale_documents'

        ELSE 'stale_documents_recovered'
    END AS recovery_status

FROM recovered;

WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF(
            $1::TEXT,
            ''
        ) AS execution_id,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                $2::TEXT,
                ''
            ),
            'all'
        ) AS processing_mode,

        GREATEST(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    $3::TEXT,
                    ''
                )::INTEGER,
                2
            ),
            1
        ) AS max_documents
),

lock_acquired AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'running',

        active_execution_id =
            parameters.execution_id,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NOW(),

        lock_expires_at =
            NOW() + INTERVAL '60 minutes',

        error_message =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                cursor.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'active_workflow',
                'WF-015',

                'active_execution_id',
                parameters.execution_id,

                'processing_mode',
                parameters.processing_mode,

                'max_documents',
                parameters.max_documents,

                'started_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM parameters

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          'SECOP_OPPORTUNITY_REQUIREMENT_EXTRACTION'

      AND (
          cursor.status IS DISTINCT FROM
              'running'

          OR cursor.lock_expires_at IS NULL

          OR cursor.lock_expires_at <
             NOW()

          OR cursor.active_execution_id =
             parameters.execution_id
      )

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.status,
        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at
)

SELECT
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM lock_acquired
    ) AS lock_acquired,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT source_code
            FROM lock_acquired
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        'SECOP_OPPORTUNITY_REQUIREMENT_EXTRACTION'
    ) AS source_code,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM lock_acquired
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS status,

    (
        SELECT active_execution_id
        FROM lock_acquired
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS active_execution_id,

    (
        SELECT lock_expires_at
        FROM lock_acquired
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS lock_expires_at;

WITH configuration AS (
    SELECT
        GREATEST(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    $1::TEXT,
                    ''
                )::INTEGER,
                2
            ),
            1
        )
            AS max_documents,

        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        BTRIM(
                            $2::TEXT
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    'all'
                )
            ) IN (
                'all',
                'pending_only',
                'outdated_only'
            )
                THEN LOWER(
                    COALESCE(
                        NULLIF(
                            BTRIM(
                                $2::TEXT
                            ),
                            ''
                        ),
                        'all'
                    )
                )

            ELSE
                'all'
        END
            AS processing_mode,

        GREATEST(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    $3::TEXT,
                    ''
                )::INTEGER,
                100
            ),
            100
        )
            AS minimum_characters,

        NULLIF(
            $4::TEXT,
            ''
        )
            AS execution_id,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                BTRIM(
                    $5::TEXT
                ),
                ''
            ),
            'models/gemini-3.1-flash-lite'
        )
            AS model_name,

        GREATEST(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    $6::TEXT,
                    ''
                )::INTEGER,
                2
            ),
            1
        )
            AS prompt_version
),

candidates AS (
    SELECT
        document.id
            AS opportunity_document_id,

        document.organization_id,
        document.opportunity_analysis_id,
        document.process_id,

        document.process_reference,
        document.document_name,
        document.primary_category,

        document.ai_requirement_status
            AS previous_requirement_status,

        COALESCE(
            document.ai_requirement_attempt_count,
            0
        )
            AS previous_attempt_count,

        COALESCE(
            document.ai_requirement_prompt_version,
            0
        )
            AS previous_prompt_version,

        CASE
            WHEN document.ai_requirement_status =
                 'completed'

             AND COALESCE(
                 document.ai_requirement_prompt_version,
                 0
             ) < configuration.prompt_version
                THEN 'prompt_version_upgrade'

            WHEN document.ai_requirement_status =
                 'failed'
                THEN 'retry_failed'

            ELSE
                'queued_document'
        END
            AS claim_reason,

        extraction.id
            AS extraction_id,

        extraction.extraction_version,
        extraction.text_content,
        extraction.character_count,
        extraction.page_count,
        extraction.text_sha256,

        configuration.execution_id,
        configuration.model_name,
        configuration.prompt_version,
        configuration.processing_mode

    FROM saas.opportunity_documents
        AS document

    CROSS JOIN configuration

    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            saved.id,
            saved.extraction_version,
            saved.text_content,
            saved.character_count,
            saved.page_count,
            saved.text_sha256

        FROM saas.opportunity_document_extractions
            AS saved

        WHERE saved.opportunity_document_id =
              document.id

          AND saved.extraction_status =
              'extracted'

        ORDER BY
            saved.extraction_version DESC,
            saved.updated_at DESC

        LIMIT 1
    )
        AS extraction
        ON TRUE

    WHERE document.download_status =
          'downloaded'

      AND document.extraction_status =
          'extracted'

      AND extraction.character_count >=
          configuration.minimum_characters

      AND (
          /*
           * Documentos pendientes o fallidos.
           */
          (
              configuration.processing_mode IN (
                  'all',
                  'pending_only'
              )

              AND document.ai_requirement_status IN (
                  'queued',
                  'failed'
              )

              AND COALESCE(
                  document.ai_requirement_attempt_count,
                  0
              ) < 3
          )

          OR

          /*
           * Documentos completados con una versión
           * anterior del prompt.
           */
          (
              configuration.processing_mode IN (
                  'all',
                  'outdated_only'
              )

              AND document.ai_requirement_status =
                  'completed'

              AND COALESCE(
                  document.ai_requirement_prompt_version,
                  0
              ) < configuration.prompt_version
          )
      )

    ORDER BY
        /*
         * Si se solicita exclusivamente actualización,
         * únicamente existirán documentos desactualizados.
         *
         * En modo general se priorizan:
         * 1. Documentos nuevos.
         * 2. Documentos con prompt antiguo.
         * 3. Reintentos fallidos.
         */
        CASE
            WHEN document.ai_requirement_status =
                 'queued'
                THEN 1

            WHEN document.ai_requirement_status =
                 'completed'

             AND COALESCE(
                 document.ai_requirement_prompt_version,
                 0
             ) < configuration.prompt_version
                THEN 2

            WHEN document.ai_requirement_status =
                 'failed'
                THEN 3

            ELSE 4
        END,

        CASE document.primary_category
            WHEN 'invitation_or_terms' THEN 1
            WHEN 'previous_studies' THEN 2
            WHEN 'entity_template' THEN 3
            WHEN 'technical_annex' THEN 4
            WHEN 'risk_matrix' THEN 5
            ELSE 6
        END,

        document.updated_at ASC

    LIMIT (
        SELECT
            max_documents

        FROM configuration
    )

    FOR UPDATE OF document
    SKIP LOCKED
),

claimed AS (
    UPDATE saas.opportunity_documents
        AS document

    SET
        ai_requirement_status =
            'running',

        /*
         * Cuando cambia la versión del prompt,
         * se reinicia el contador de intentos.
         *
         * Cuando es un reintento de la misma
         * versión, se incrementa normalmente.
         */
        ai_requirement_attempt_count =
            CASE
                WHEN candidate.previous_prompt_version <
                     candidate.prompt_version
                    THEN 1

                ELSE COALESCE(
                    document.ai_requirement_attempt_count,
                    0
                ) + 1
            END,

        ai_requirement_started_at =
            NOW(),

        ai_requirement_finished_at =
            NULL,

        ai_requirement_error =
            NULL,

        ai_requirement_model =
            candidate.model_name,

        ai_requirement_prompt_version =
            candidate.prompt_version,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                document.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'active_requirement_execution_id',
                candidate.execution_id,

                'active_requirement_started_at',
                NOW(),

                'active_requirement_processing_mode',
                candidate.processing_mode,

                'active_requirement_claim_reason',
                candidate.claim_reason,

                'previous_requirement_status',
                candidate.previous_requirement_status,

                'previous_requirement_attempt_count',
                candidate.previous_attempt_count,

                'previous_requirement_prompt_version',
                candidate.previous_prompt_version,

                'target_requirement_prompt_version',
                candidate.prompt_version,

                'requirement_reanalysis',
                (
                    candidate.claim_reason =
                    'prompt_version_upgrade'
                )
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM candidates
        AS candidate

    WHERE document.id =
          candidate.opportunity_document_id

    RETURNING
        document.id
            AS opportunity_document_id,

        document.organization_id,
        document.opportunity_analysis_id,
        document.process_id,

        document.process_reference,
        document.document_name,
        document.primary_category,

        candidate.extraction_id,
        candidate.extraction_version,
        candidate.text_content,
        candidate.character_count,
        candidate.page_count,
        candidate.text_sha256,

        document.ai_requirement_attempt_count,
        document.ai_requirement_model,
        document.ai_requirement_prompt_version,

        candidate.previous_requirement_status,
        candidate.previous_attempt_count,
        candidate.previous_prompt_version,
        candidate.claim_reason,
        candidate.processing_mode
)

SELECT
    claimed.opportunity_document_id,
    claimed.organization_id,
    claimed.opportunity_analysis_id,
    claimed.process_id,

    claimed.process_reference,
    claimed.document_name,
    claimed.primary_category,

    claimed.extraction_id,
    claimed.extraction_version,
    claimed.text_content,
    claimed.character_count,
    claimed.page_count,
    claimed.text_sha256,

    claimed.ai_requirement_attempt_count,
    claimed.ai_requirement_model,
    claimed.ai_requirement_prompt_version,

    claimed.previous_requirement_status,
    claimed.previous_attempt_count,
    claimed.previous_prompt_version,
    claimed.claim_reason,
    claimed.processing_mode

FROM claimed;

nodes.name: Procesar documentos uno a uno WF-015

parameters.query:
WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF(
            $1::TEXT,
            ''
        ) AS execution_id
),

released AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'success',

        active_execution_id =
            NULL,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NULL,

        lock_expires_at =
            NULL,

        error_message =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                cursor.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'last_successful_workflow',
                'WF-015',

                'last_successful_execution_id',
                parameters.execution_id,

                'last_successful_finished_at',
                NOW(),

                'lock_released_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM parameters

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          'SECOP_OPPORTUNITY_REQUIREMENT_EXTRACTION'

      AND cursor.active_execution_id =
          parameters.execution_id

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.status,
        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at,
        cursor.error_message,
        cursor.updated_at
),

current_state AS (
    SELECT
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.status,
        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at,
        cursor.error_message,
        cursor.updated_at

    FROM ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          'SECOP_OPPORTUNITY_REQUIREMENT_EXTRACTION'

    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    TRUE
        AS lock_released,

    released.source_code,
    released.status,
    released.active_execution_id,
    released.lock_acquired_at,
    released.lock_expires_at,
    released.error_message,
    released.updated_at,

    'lock_released'
        AS release_result

FROM released

UNION ALL

SELECT
    FALSE
        AS lock_released,

    state.source_code,
    state.status,
    state.active_execution_id,
    state.lock_acquired_at,
    state.lock_expires_at,
    state.error_message,
    state.updated_at,

    CASE
        WHEN state.active_execution_id
             IS NULL

         AND state.status IN (
             'idle',
             'success'
         )
            THEN 'already_released'

        ELSE 'lock_owned_by_another_execution'
    END AS release_result

FROM current_state
    AS state

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM released
);

const cleanText = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/\u0000/g, '')
    .replace(/\r\n/g, '\n')
    .replace(/[ \t]+\n/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\n{4,}/g, '\n\n\n')
    .trim();

const fullText = cleanText(
  $json.text_content
);

if (fullText.length < 100) {
  throw new Error(
    'El documento no contiene texto suficiente para analizar requisitos.'
  );
}

/*
 * Versión 2 del análisis documental.
 *
 * Se analizan hasta 70.000 caracteres:
 * - 55.000 caracteres iniciales.
 * - 15.000 caracteres finales.
 *
 * En una versión posterior se implementará
 * fragmentación completa de documentos extensos.
 */
let documentText =
  fullText;

if (fullText.length > 70000) {
  const beginning =
    fullText.slice(
      0,
      55000
    );

  const ending =
    fullText.slice(
      -15000
    );

  documentText =
    `${beginning}\n\n`
    + '[... CONTENIDO INTERMEDIO OMITIDO EN ESTA EJECUCIÓN ...]'
    + `\n\n${ending}`;
}

const systemPrompt = `
Actúa como especialista senior en contratación pública colombiana y análisis documental de procesos SECOP II.

Tu tarea es identificar exclusivamente requisitos documentales, jurídicos, tributarios, fiscales, disciplinarios, financieros, técnicos, administrativos, de experiencia, seguridad social y formatos que una persona natural, persona jurídica, consorcio, unión temporal, representante legal, contador, revisor fiscal, integrante del equipo de trabajo u otro sujeto deba presentar, acreditar, diligenciar, firmar, anexar o mantener vigente.

REGLAS OBLIGATORIAS

1. No inventes requisitos.

2. No confundas las características técnicas del objeto contractual, las obligaciones del contratista, las especificaciones de bienes o servicios ni las condiciones de ejecución con documentos exigidos a un participante.

3. Cada requisito debe estar respaldado por texto presente en el documento.

4. No agregues un requisito cuando no exista evidence_text que lo respalde.

5. evidence_text debe ser un fragmento breve, preciso y no superar 450 caracteres.

6. Identifica si el requisito es obligatorio o condicional.

7. Cuando el texto utilice expresiones como:

- "si"
- "cuando"
- "en caso de"
- "cuando aplique"
- "si aplica"
- "de ser necesario"
- "en el evento de"
- "para cuando"
- "cuando corresponda"

o expresiones equivalentes, debes marcar:

"mandatory": false

y debes explicar la condición en:

"condition_text"

8. Cuando el requisito sea exigido siempre y sin condición expresa, utiliza:

"mandatory": true

9. Identifica la vigencia máxima del documento solamente cuando aparezca expresamente en el texto.

10. Cuando maximum_age_days no aparezca expresamente, devuelve:

"maximum_age_days": 0

11. No deduzcas vigencias usando conocimientos externos o políticas internas de la empresa.

12. Identifica si el documento necesita:

- firma
- formato o plantilla de la entidad
- documento original
- autenticación o notarización
- traducción

13. Cuando una oración exija dos o más documentos independientes, crea un requisito separado para cada documento.

14. No agrupes documentos diferentes en un solo requisito.

Ejemplo:

Si el texto exige una planilla pagada de seguridad social y una certificación firmada por el revisor fiscal, debes crear dos requisitos diferentes.

15. Identifica la etapa en la que se exige cada requisito.

Los únicos valores permitidos para requirement_stage son:

- bid_submission
- eligibility
- evaluation
- award
- contract_signing
- contract_execution
- payment
- other

16. Utiliza "bid_submission" cuando el documento deba entregarse con la presentación inicial de la oferta.

17. Utiliza "eligibility" cuando el documento sea empleado para verificar requisitos habilitantes jurídicos, financieros, técnicos, de experiencia o capacidad organizacional.

18. Utiliza "evaluation" cuando el documento sea requerido para asignar puntaje, comparar propuestas, subsanar o evaluar una oferta.

19. Utiliza "award" cuando el documento se exija únicamente al adjudicatario antes de la adjudicación definitiva.

20. Utiliza "contract_signing" cuando el documento se exija para legalizar, perfeccionar o firmar el contrato.

21. Utiliza "contract_execution" cuando el documento se exija durante la ejecución del contrato.

22. Utiliza "payment" cuando el documento sea necesario exclusivamente para:

- facturación
- cobro
- giro electrónico
- desembolso
- cambio de cuenta bancaria
- trámite de pago

23. Utiliza "other" cuando la etapa no pueda determinarse con suficiente evidencia.

24. Distingue cuidadosamente entre documentos exigidos al presentar la oferta y documentos solicitados únicamente al adjudicatario, contratista o proveedor durante la ejecución o el pago.

25. No clasifiques como requisito de presentación de oferta un documento solicitado únicamente para:

- facturación
- giro electrónico
- legalización
- firma del contrato
- ejecución contractual
- cobro
- pago

26. No conviertas automáticamente las obligaciones contractuales en requisitos documentales.

27. Identifica el sujeto al que aplica el requisito mediante applies_to.

Los valores permitidos para applies_to son:

- bidder
- legal_representative
- legal_entity
- natural_person
- consortium_member
- temporary_union_member
- accountant
- statutory_auditor
- technical_staff
- subcontractor
- other

28. Cuando applies_to no pueda determinarse, devuelve:

"applies_to": "other"

29. source_page debe contener el número de página solamente cuando pueda determinarse con suficiente claridad.

30. Cuando source_page no pueda determinarse, devuelve:

"source_page": 0

31. confidence_score debe estar entre 0 y 1.

32. confidence_score representa la claridad de la evidencia documental, no la seguridad subjetiva del modelo.

33. Utiliza confidence_score igual a 1 únicamente cuando sean totalmente explícitos:

- el documento exigido
- el sujeto obligado
- la condición
- la etapa
- la evidencia

34. No utilices valores null.

35. Cuando un valor textual no aparezca, devuelve una cadena vacía "".

36. Devuelve únicamente JSON válido.

37. No utilices markdown.

38. No utilices bloques de código.

39. No escribas explicaciones, introducciones, conclusiones o comentarios fuera del JSON.

40. La respuesta debe comenzar directamente con el carácter { y terminar directamente con el carácter }.

CATEGORÍAS PERMITIDAS

Los únicos valores permitidos para requirement_category son:

- legal
- tax
- disciplinary
- fiscal
- social_security
- financial
- experience
- technical
- administrative
- entity_template
- signature
- consortium
- other

ESTRUCTURA EXACTA DE RESPUESTA

{
  "document_summary": "Resumen breve del documento analizado",
  "requirements": [
    {
      "requirement_category": "legal",
      "requirement_name": "Nombre claro del requisito",
      "normalized_document_type": "chamber_of_commerce",
      "requirement_description": "Descripción precisa de lo que debe presentar o acreditar el sujeto obligado",
      "mandatory": true,
      "condition_text": "",
      "maximum_age_days": 30,
      "requires_signature": false,
      "requires_entity_template": false,
      "requires_original": false,
      "requires_notarization": false,
      "requires_translation": false,
      "applies_to": "bidder",
      "requirement_stage": "eligibility",
      "source_page": 5,
      "source_section": "Requisitos habilitantes",
      "evidence_text": "Fragmento breve y literal que respalda el requisito",
      "confidence_score": 0.95
    }
  ]
}

Cuando el documento no contenga requisitos documentales, devuelve exactamente un objeto con esta estructura:

{
  "document_summary": "Resumen breve del documento analizado",
  "requirements": []
}
`.trim();

const userPrompt = `
DOCUMENTO A ANALIZAR

Referencia del proceso:
${$json.process_reference ?? ''}

Nombre del documento:
${$json.document_name ?? ''}

Categoría documental:
${$json.primary_category ?? ''}

Cantidad estimada de páginas:
${$json.page_count ?? 'desconocida'}

Cantidad total de caracteres:
${fullText.length}

El documento fue truncado para este análisis:
${fullText.length > 70000 ? 'sí' : 'no'}

CONTENIDO DEL DOCUMENTO

${documentText}
`.trim();

return {
  json: {
    ...$json,

    system_prompt:
      systemPrompt,

    user_prompt:
      userPrompt,

    source_character_count:
      fullText.length,

    analyzed_character_count:
      documentText.length,

    document_was_truncated:
      fullText.length > 70000,

    prompt_version:
      2,

    prepared_at:
      new Date().toISOString(),
  },
};

parameters.query:
WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF(
            $1::TEXT,
            ''
        )::UUID
            AS opportunity_document_id,

        NULLIF(
            $2::TEXT,
            ''
        )::UUID
            AS organization_id,

        NULLIF(
            $3::TEXT,
            ''
        )::UUID
            AS opportunity_analysis_id,

        NULLIF(
            $4::TEXT,
            ''
        )::UUID
            AS process_id,

        NULLIF(
            $5::TEXT,
            ''
        )::UUID
            AS extraction_id,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                $6::TEXT,
                ''
            )::INTEGER,
            1
        )
            AS extraction_version,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                BTRIM(
                    $7::TEXT
                ),
                ''
            ),
            'unknown'
        )
            AS ai_model,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                $8::TEXT,
                ''
            )::INTEGER,
            2
        )
            AS prompt_version,

        CASE
            WHEN JSONB_TYPEOF(
                COALESCE(
                    $9::JSONB,
                    '[]'::JSONB
                )
            ) = 'array'
                THEN COALESCE(
                    $9::JSONB,
                    '[]'::JSONB
                )

            ELSE
                '[]'::JSONB
        END
            AS requirements,

        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                $10::TEXT
            ),
            ''
        )
            AS document_summary
),

raw_incoming AS (
    SELECT
        parameters.*,

        requirement.value
            AS requirement_data,

        requirement.ordinality::INTEGER
            AS requirement_order,

        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(
                BTRIM(
                    COALESCE(
                        requirement.value
                            ->> 'requirement_stage',
                        'other'
                    )
                )
            ) IN (
                'bid_submission',
                'eligibility',
                'evaluation',
                'award',
                'contract_signing',
                'contract_execution',
                'payment',
                'other'
            )
                THEN LOWER(
                    BTRIM(
                        COALESCE(
                            requirement.value
                                ->> 'requirement_stage',
                            'other'
                        )
                    )
                )

            ELSE
                'other'
        END
            AS normalized_requirement_stage

    FROM parameters

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL
        JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(
            parameters.requirements
        ) WITH ORDINALITY
        AS requirement(
            value,
            ordinality
        )

    WHERE JSONB_TYPEOF(
        requirement.value
    ) = 'object'
),

incoming AS (
    SELECT
        raw_incoming.*,

        ENCODE(
            DIGEST(
                CONCAT_WS(
                    '|',

                    LOWER(
                        BTRIM(
                            COALESCE(
                                raw_incoming.requirement_data
                                    ->> 'requirement_category',
                                'other'
                            )
                        )
                    ),

                    LOWER(
                        BTRIM(
                            COALESCE(
                                raw_incoming.requirement_data
                                    ->> 'requirement_name',
                                ''
                            )
                        )
                    ),

                    LOWER(
                        BTRIM(
                            COALESCE(
                                raw_incoming.requirement_data
                                    ->> 'normalized_document_type',
                                ''
                            )
                        )
                    ),

                    LOWER(
                        BTRIM(
                            COALESCE(
                                raw_incoming.requirement_data
                                    ->> 'applies_to',
                                'other'
                            )
                        )
                    ),

                    raw_incoming
                        .normalized_requirement_stage,

                    COALESCE(
                        raw_incoming.requirement_data
                            ->> 'maximum_age_days',
                        ''
                    ),

                    COALESCE(
                        raw_incoming.requirement_data
                            ->> 'requires_signature',
                        'false'
                    ),

                    COALESCE(
                        raw_incoming.requirement_data
                            ->> 'requires_entity_template',
                        'false'
                    ),

                    COALESCE(
                        raw_incoming.requirement_data
                            ->> 'requires_original',
                        'false'
                    ),

                    COALESCE(
                        raw_incoming.requirement_data
                            ->> 'requires_notarization',
                        'false'
                    ),

                    COALESCE(
                        raw_incoming.requirement_data
                            ->> 'requires_translation',
                        'false'
                    )
                ),

                'sha256'
            ),

            'hex'
        )
            AS requirement_hash

    FROM raw_incoming
),

deduplicated AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (
        incoming.requirement_hash
    )
        incoming.*

    FROM incoming

    WHERE NULLIF(
        BTRIM(
            incoming.requirement_data
                ->> 'requirement_name'
        ),
        ''
    ) IS NOT NULL

      AND NULLIF(
          BTRIM(
              incoming.requirement_data
                  ->> 'evidence_text'
          ),
          ''
      ) IS NOT NULL

    ORDER BY
        incoming.requirement_hash,
        incoming.requirement_order
),

upserted AS (
    INSERT INTO saas.opportunity_requirements
        AS stored_requirement
    (
        organization_id,
        opportunity_analysis_id,
        process_id,
        opportunity_document_id,
        extraction_id,

        category,
        requirement_category,
        requirement_name,
        normalized_document_type,
        requirement_description,

        mandatory,
        condition_text,
        maximum_age_days,

        requires_signature,
        requires_entity_template,
        requires_original,
        requires_notarization,
        requires_translation,

        applies_to,
        requirement_stage,
        is_bid_requirement,

        source_page,
        source_section,
        evidence_text,
        confidence_score,

        extraction_version,
        requirement_hash_sha256,
        status,
        ai_model,
        metadata,

        created_at,
        updated_at
    )

    SELECT
        deduplicated.organization_id,
        deduplicated.opportunity_analysis_id,
        deduplicated.process_id,
        deduplicated.opportunity_document_id,
        deduplicated.extraction_id,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                LOWER(
                    BTRIM(
                        deduplicated.requirement_data
                            ->> 'requirement_category'
                    )
                ),
                ''
            ),
            'other'
        )
            AS category,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                LOWER(
                    BTRIM(
                        deduplicated.requirement_data
                            ->> 'requirement_category'
                    )
                ),
                ''
            ),
            'other'
        )
            AS requirement_category,

        BTRIM(
            deduplicated.requirement_data
                ->> 'requirement_name'
        )
            AS requirement_name,

        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                deduplicated.requirement_data
                    ->> 'normalized_document_type'
            ),
            ''
        )
            AS normalized_document_type,

        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                deduplicated.requirement_data
                    ->> 'requirement_description'
            ),
            ''
        )
            AS requirement_description,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                deduplicated.requirement_data
                    ->> 'mandatory',
                ''
            )::BOOLEAN,
            TRUE
        )
            AS mandatory,

        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                deduplicated.requirement_data
                    ->> 'condition_text'
            ),
            ''
        )
            AS condition_text,

        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(
                deduplicated.requirement_data
                    ->> 'maximum_age_days',
                ''
            ) ~ '^[0-9]+$'

             AND (
                deduplicated.requirement_data
                    ->> 'maximum_age_days'
             )::INTEGER > 0
                THEN (
                    deduplicated.requirement_data
                        ->> 'maximum_age_days'
                )::INTEGER

            ELSE
                NULL
        END
            AS maximum_age_days,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                deduplicated.requirement_data
                    ->> 'requires_signature',
                ''
            )::BOOLEAN,
            FALSE
        )
            AS requires_signature,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                deduplicated.requirement_data
                    ->> 'requires_entity_template',
                ''
            )::BOOLEAN,
            FALSE
        )
            AS requires_entity_template,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                deduplicated.requirement_data
                    ->> 'requires_original',
                ''
            )::BOOLEAN,
            FALSE
        )
            AS requires_original,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                deduplicated.requirement_data
                    ->> 'requires_notarization',
                ''
            )::BOOLEAN,
            FALSE
        )
            AS requires_notarization,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                deduplicated.requirement_data
                    ->> 'requires_translation',
                ''
            )::BOOLEAN,
            FALSE
        )
            AS requires_translation,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                LOWER(
                    BTRIM(
                        deduplicated.requirement_data
                            ->> 'applies_to'
                    )
                ),
                ''
            ),
            'other'
        )
            AS applies_to,

        deduplicated
            .normalized_requirement_stage
            AS requirement_stage,

        (
            deduplicated
                .normalized_requirement_stage
            IN (
                'bid_submission',
                'eligibility',
                'evaluation'
            )
        )
            AS is_bid_requirement,

        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(
                deduplicated.requirement_data
                    ->> 'source_page',
                ''
            ) ~ '^[0-9]+$'

             AND (
                deduplicated.requirement_data
                    ->> 'source_page'
             )::INTEGER > 0
                THEN (
                    deduplicated.requirement_data
                        ->> 'source_page'
                )::INTEGER

            ELSE
                NULL
        END
            AS source_page,

        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                deduplicated.requirement_data
                    ->> 'source_section'
            ),
            ''
        )
            AS source_section,

        LEFT(
            NULLIF(
                BTRIM(
                    deduplicated.requirement_data
                        ->> 'evidence_text'
                ),
                ''
            ),
            450
        )
            AS evidence_text,

        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(
                deduplicated.requirement_data
                    ->> 'confidence_score',
                ''
            ) ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
                THEN LEAST(
                    1::NUMERIC,

                    GREATEST(
                        0::NUMERIC,

                        (
                            deduplicated.requirement_data
                                ->> 'confidence_score'
                        )::NUMERIC
                    )
                )::NUMERIC(5,4)

            ELSE
                NULL
        END
            AS confidence_score,

        deduplicated.extraction_version,

        deduplicated.requirement_hash,

        CASE
            WHEN
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(
                        deduplicated.requirement_data
                            ->> 'confidence_score',
                        ''
                    ) ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
                        THEN (
                            deduplicated.requirement_data
                                ->> 'confidence_score'
                        )::NUMERIC

                    ELSE
                        0::NUMERIC
                END < 0.60
                THEN 'review_required'

            ELSE
                'active'
        END
            AS status,

        deduplicated.ai_model,

        jsonb_build_object(
            'prompt_version',
            deduplicated.prompt_version,

            'requirement_order',
            deduplicated.requirement_order,

            'requirement_stage',
            deduplicated
                .normalized_requirement_stage,

            'is_bid_requirement',
            (
                deduplicated
                    .normalized_requirement_stage
                IN (
                    'bid_submission',
                    'eligibility',
                    'evaluation'
                )
            ),

            'document_summary',
            deduplicated.document_summary,

            'saved_by',
            'WF-015',

            'saved_at',
            NOW()
        )
            AS metadata,

        NOW()
            AS created_at,

        NOW()
            AS updated_at

    FROM deduplicated

    ON CONFLICT (
        opportunity_document_id,
        requirement_hash_sha256,
        extraction_version
    )

    DO UPDATE SET
        organization_id =
            EXCLUDED.organization_id,

        opportunity_analysis_id =
            EXCLUDED.opportunity_analysis_id,

        process_id =
            EXCLUDED.process_id,

        extraction_id =
            EXCLUDED.extraction_id,

        category =
            EXCLUDED.category,

        requirement_category =
            EXCLUDED.requirement_category,

        requirement_name =
            EXCLUDED.requirement_name,

        normalized_document_type =
            EXCLUDED.normalized_document_type,

        requirement_description =
            EXCLUDED.requirement_description,

        mandatory =
            EXCLUDED.mandatory,

        condition_text =
            EXCLUDED.condition_text,

        maximum_age_days =
            EXCLUDED.maximum_age_days,

        requires_signature =
            EXCLUDED.requires_signature,

        requires_entity_template =
            EXCLUDED.requires_entity_template,

        requires_original =
            EXCLUDED.requires_original,

        requires_notarization =
            EXCLUDED.requires_notarization,

        requires_translation =
            EXCLUDED.requires_translation,

        applies_to =
            EXCLUDED.applies_to,

        requirement_stage =
            EXCLUDED.requirement_stage,

        is_bid_requirement =
            EXCLUDED.is_bid_requirement,

        source_page =
            EXCLUDED.source_page,

        source_section =
            EXCLUDED.source_section,

        evidence_text =
            EXCLUDED.evidence_text,

        confidence_score =
            EXCLUDED.confidence_score,

        status =
            EXCLUDED.status,

        ai_model =
            EXCLUDED.ai_model,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                stored_requirement.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || EXCLUDED.metadata,

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    RETURNING
        stored_requirement.id,

        stored_requirement
            .opportunity_document_id,

        stored_requirement
            .requirement_hash_sha256,

        stored_requirement
            .requirement_stage,

        stored_requirement
            .is_bid_requirement,

        stored_requirement.status
),

archived AS (
    UPDATE saas.opportunity_requirements
        AS existing_requirement

    SET
        status =
            'archived',

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                existing_requirement.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'archived_by',
                'WF-015',

                'archived_at',
                NOW(),

                'archive_reason',
                'El requisito no apareció en la extracción vigente.'
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM parameters

    WHERE existing_requirement
              .opportunity_document_id =
          parameters
              .opportunity_document_id

      AND existing_requirement.status IN (
          'active',
          'review_required'
      )

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1

          FROM upserted

          WHERE upserted.id =
                existing_requirement.id
      )

    RETURNING
        existing_requirement.id
),

execution_summary AS (
    SELECT
        parameters.opportunity_document_id,
        parameters.ai_model,
        parameters.prompt_version,
        parameters.extraction_version,
        parameters.document_summary,

        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM upserted
        )::INTEGER
            AS requirements_saved,

        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM upserted
            WHERE status = 'active'
        )::INTEGER
            AS active_requirements,

        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM upserted
            WHERE status = 'review_required'
        )::INTEGER
            AS review_required_requirements,

        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM upserted
            WHERE is_bid_requirement = TRUE
        )::INTEGER
            AS bid_requirements,

        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM upserted
            WHERE is_bid_requirement = FALSE
        )::INTEGER
            AS non_bid_requirements,

        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM archived
        )::INTEGER
            AS requirements_archived

    FROM parameters
),

document_updated AS (
    UPDATE saas.opportunity_documents
        AS document

    SET
        ai_requirement_status =
            'completed',

        ai_requirement_finished_at =
            NOW(),

        ai_requirement_error =
            NULL,

        ai_requirement_model =
            execution_summary.ai_model,

        ai_requirement_prompt_version =
            execution_summary.prompt_version,

        ai_requirement_count =
            execution_summary
                .requirements_saved,

        metadata =
            (
                COALESCE(
                    document.metadata,
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )
                - 'active_requirement_execution_id'
                - 'active_requirement_started_at'
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'last_requirement_analysis_at',
                NOW(),

                'last_requirement_analysis_workflow',
                'WF-015',

                'last_requirement_analysis_model',
                execution_summary.ai_model,

                'last_requirement_prompt_version',
                execution_summary.prompt_version,

                'last_requirement_extraction_version',
                execution_summary.extraction_version,

                'last_requirement_count',
                execution_summary.requirements_saved,

                'last_active_requirement_count',
                execution_summary.active_requirements,

                'last_review_required_count',
                execution_summary
                    .review_required_requirements,

                'last_bid_requirement_count',
                execution_summary.bid_requirements,

                'last_non_bid_requirement_count',
                execution_summary.non_bid_requirements,

                'last_archived_requirement_count',
                execution_summary
                    .requirements_archived,

                'last_document_summary',
                execution_summary.document_summary
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM execution_summary

    WHERE document.id =
          execution_summary
              .opportunity_document_id

    RETURNING
        document.id
            AS opportunity_document_id,

        document.organization_id,
        document.opportunity_analysis_id,
        document.process_id,

        document.process_reference,
        document.document_name,
        document.primary_category,

        document.ai_requirement_status,
        document.ai_requirement_attempt_count,
        document.ai_requirement_count,
        document.ai_requirement_model,
        document.ai_requirement_prompt_version,
        document.ai_requirement_error,
        document.updated_at
)

SELECT
    document_updated
        .opportunity_document_id,

    document_updated.organization_id,
    document_updated
        .opportunity_analysis_id,

    document_updated.process_id,

    document_updated.process_reference,
    document_updated.document_name,
    document_updated.primary_category,

    document_updated
        .ai_requirement_status,

    document_updated
        .ai_requirement_attempt_count,

    document_updated
        .ai_requirement_count,

    document_updated
        .ai_requirement_model,

    document_updated
        .ai_requirement_prompt_version,

    document_updated
        .ai_requirement_error,

    execution_summary
        .requirements_saved,

    execution_summary
        .active_requirements,

    execution_summary
        .review_required_requirements,

    execution_summary
        .bid_requirements,

    execution_summary
        .non_bid_requirements,

    execution_summary
        .requirements_archived,

    document_updated.updated_at,

    TRUE
        AS requirements_stored,

    'success'
        AS save_result

FROM document_updated

JOIN execution_summary
    ON execution_summary
           .opportunity_document_id =
       document_updated
           .opportunity_document_id;

WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF(
            $1::TEXT,
            ''
        )::UUID
            AS opportunity_document_id,

        LEFT(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    $2::TEXT,
                    ''
                ),
                'La respuesta de la IA no fue válida.'
            ),
            5000
        ) AS error_message,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                $3::TEXT,
                ''
            ),
            'unknown'
        ) AS model_name,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                $4::TEXT,
                ''
            ),
            'WF-015'
        ) AS workflow_code,

        NULLIF(
            $5::TEXT,
            ''
        ) AS execution_id
),

document_updated AS (
    UPDATE saas.opportunity_documents
        AS document

    SET
        ai_requirement_status =
            'failed',

        ai_requirement_finished_at =
            NOW(),

        ai_requirement_error =
            parameters.error_message,

        metadata =
            (
                COALESCE(
                    document.metadata,
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )
                - 'active_requirement_execution_id'
                - 'active_requirement_started_at'
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'last_requirement_failure_at',
                NOW(),

                'last_requirement_failure_workflow',
                parameters.workflow_code,

                'last_requirement_failure_execution_id',
                parameters.execution_id,

                'last_requirement_failure_model',
                parameters.model_name,

                'last_requirement_failure_message',
                parameters.error_message
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM parameters

    WHERE document.id =
          parameters.opportunity_document_id

      AND parameters.opportunity_document_id
          IS NOT NULL

    RETURNING
        document.id
            AS opportunity_document_id,

        document.organization_id,
        document.opportunity_analysis_id,
        document.process_id,

        document.process_reference,
        document.document_name,

        document.ai_requirement_status,
        document.ai_requirement_attempt_count,
        document.ai_requirement_error,
        document.updated_at
)

SELECT
    updated.opportunity_document_id,
    updated.organization_id,
    updated.opportunity_analysis_id,
    updated.process_id,

    updated.process_reference,
    updated.document_name,

    updated.ai_requirement_status,
    updated.ai_requirement_attempt_count,
    updated.ai_requirement_error,
    updated.updated_at,

    TRUE
        AS failure_registered,

    'ai_failure_registered'
        AS failure_result

FROM document_updated
    AS updated

UNION ALL

SELECT
    parameters.opportunity_document_id,
    NULL::UUID,
    NULL::UUID,
    NULL::UUID,

    NULL::TEXT,
    NULL::TEXT,

    'failed'::VARCHAR,
    NULL::INTEGER,
    parameters.error_message,
    NOW(),

    FALSE
        AS failure_registered,

    CASE
        WHEN parameters.opportunity_document_id
             IS NULL
            THEN 'missing_document_context'

        ELSE 'document_not_found'
    END AS failure_result

FROM parameters

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM document_updated
);

  },
};

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ops.workflow_runs (
    workflow_code,
    source_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    trigger_type,
    status,
    started_at,
    finished_at,

    batches_processed,
    records_read,
    records_written,

    completion_reason,
    error_node,
    error_message,
    error_details,
    metadata,

    created_at,
    updated_at
)

VALUES (
    'WF-015',

    'SECOP_OPPORTUNITY_REQUIREMENT_EXTRACTION',

    $1::TEXT,

    NULLIF(
        $2::TEXT,
        ''
    ),

    'skipped',

    NOW(),
    NOW(),

    0,
    0,
    0,

    'concurrent_execution',

    NULL,

    'La ejecución fue omitida porque otra ejecución de WF-015 posee el bloqueo.',

    '{}'::JSONB,

    jsonb_strip_nulls(
        jsonb_build_object(
            'workflow_code',
            'WF-015',

            'workflow_name',
            'Extracción IA de requisitos documentales',

            'skip_reason',
            'concurrent_execution',

            'blocking_execution_id',
            NULLIF(
                $3::TEXT,
                ''
            ),

            'blocking_lock_expires_at',
            NULLIF(
                $4::TEXT,
                ''
            ),

            'registered_by',
            'WF-015',

            'skipped_at',
            NOW()
        )
    ),

    NOW(),
    NOW()
)

ON CONFLICT (
    n8n_execution_id
)

DO UPDATE SET
    workflow_code =
        EXCLUDED.workflow_code,

    source_code =
        EXCLUDED.source_code,

    trigger_type =
        EXCLUDED.trigger_type,

    status =
        'skipped',

    finished_at =
        NOW(),

    batches_processed =
        0,

    records_read =
        0,

    records_written =
        0,

    completion_reason =
        'concurrent_execution',

    error_node =
        NULL,

    error_message =
        EXCLUDED.error_message,

    error_details =
        '{}'::JSONB,

    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            ops.workflow_runs.metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        || EXCLUDED.metadata,

    updated_at =
        NOW()

RETURNING
    id
        AS workflow_run_id,

    workflow_code,
    source_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    status,
    completion_reason,
    error_message,
    started_at,
    finished_at,
    metadata;

WITH target_run AS (
    SELECT
        run.id,
        run.n8n_execution_id,
        run.started_at

    FROM ops.workflow_runs
        AS run

    WHERE run.n8n_execution_id =
          $1::TEXT

      AND run.workflow_code =
          'WF-015'

    LIMIT 1
),

document_events AS (
    SELECT
        target_run.started_at,

        document.id
            AS opportunity_document_id,

        document.ai_requirement_status,
        document.ai_requirement_count,

        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(
                document.metadata
                    ->> 'last_requirement_analysis_at',
                ''
            ) ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'

                THEN (
                    document.metadata
                        ->> 'last_requirement_analysis_at'
                )::TIMESTAMPTZ

            ELSE NULL
        END AS analysis_finished_at,

        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(
                document.metadata
                    ->> 'last_requirement_failure_at',
                ''
            ) ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'

                THEN (
                    document.metadata
                        ->> 'last_requirement_failure_at'
                )::TIMESTAMPTZ

            ELSE NULL
        END AS analysis_failed_at

    FROM target_run

    CROSS JOIN saas.opportunity_documents
        AS document
),

execution_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE
                analysis_finished_at >=
                started_at

             OR analysis_failed_at >=
                started_at
        )::BIGINT
            AS documents_processed,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE ai_requirement_status =
                  'completed'

              AND analysis_finished_at >=
                  started_at
        )::BIGINT
            AS documents_completed,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE ai_requirement_status =
                  'failed'

              AND analysis_failed_at >=
                  started_at
        )::BIGINT
            AS documents_failed,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(
                ai_requirement_count
            ) FILTER (
                WHERE ai_requirement_status =
                      'completed'

                  AND analysis_finished_at >=
                      started_at
            ),
            0
        )::BIGINT
            AS requirements_saved

    FROM document_events
),

run_updated AS (
    UPDATE ops.workflow_runs
        AS run

    SET
        status =
            'success',

        finished_at =
            NOW(),

        batches_processed =
            CASE
                WHEN execution_metrics
                        .documents_processed > 0
                    THEN 1

                ELSE 0
            END,

        records_read =
            execution_metrics
                .documents_processed,

        records_written =
            execution_metrics
                .requirements_saved,

        completion_reason =
            CASE
                WHEN execution_metrics
                        .documents_processed = 0
                    THEN 'no_documents'

                WHEN execution_metrics
                        .documents_failed > 0
                    THEN 'completed_with_document_errors'

                ELSE 'completed'
            END,

        error_node =
            NULL,

        error_message =
            NULL,

        error_details =
            '{}'::JSONB,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                run.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'documents_processed',
                execution_metrics
                    .documents_processed,

                'documents_completed',
                execution_metrics
                    .documents_completed,

                'documents_failed',
                execution_metrics
                    .documents_failed,

                'requirements_saved',
                execution_metrics
                    .requirements_saved,

                'last_successful_execution_id',
                $1::TEXT,

                'finished_by',
                'WF-015',

                'finished_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM execution_metrics

    WHERE run.n8n_execution_id =
          $1::TEXT

      AND run.workflow_code =
          'WF-015'

    RETURNING
        run.id
            AS workflow_run_id,

        run.workflow_code,
        run.source_code,
        run.n8n_execution_id,
        run.status,
        run.started_at,
        run.finished_at,

        run.batches_processed,
        run.records_read,
        run.records_written,

        run.completion_reason,
        run.error_message,
        run.metadata,
        run.updated_at
)

SELECT
    run_updated.*,

    TRUE
        AS execution_finalized,

    'workflow_run_completed'
        AS finalization_result

FROM run_updated

UNION ALL

SELECT
    NULL::UUID,
    'WF-015'::VARCHAR,
    'SECOP_OPPORTUNITY_REQUIREMENT_EXTRACTION'::VARCHAR,
    $1::TEXT,
    'failed'::VARCHAR,
    NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ,
    NOW(),
    0,
    0::BIGINT,
    0::BIGINT,
    'workflow_run_not_found'::VARCHAR,
    'No se encontró el registro inicial de la ejecución.'::TEXT,
    '{}'::JSONB,
    NOW(),

    FALSE
        AS execution_finalized,

    'workflow_run_not_found'
        AS finalization_result

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM run_updated
);
